## 席位核对 · PR #34539 · L1-b · 2026-11-17T00:28Z

Head-sha: 92fc05bc98a0f245582294af53afb8bffb60b9f6（merge-base 0e2ead3c1；16 个文件，+303/−41；dev 报告 6933675442，状态说明 6933704412）

**结论：REWORK（2 项，都在正文和 changeset 的文字上；代码可以接受）**

### 已核对、没有问题的部分

- **形态**：写的是 `Part of #32984`，对应裁决 6929121584 Q1 B 的 console 读取一侧。
- **`publishHealthFromResponse`**：
  - `userMessage`、`fix` 只在是非空字符串时才读；
  - `seedFailed` 来自 `success === false`；
  - `seedError` 只放生产方给的文字，不再自己编英文；
  - `errors[0]` 是对象时，取它的 `message`。
- **`PublishHealthLine`**：
  - 有 `userMessage` 的结果显示这句话；
  - 没有的，整组只出一句通用句：有 error 时用 `issuesSummary`，否则用 `warningsSummary`；
  - `message`、`fix` 和 `seedError` 一律折进「技术详情」；
  - 种子失败显示 `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`；
  - 判断"本行是否为空"时，已把 `seedFailed` 算进去。
- **i18n**：`seedFailed` 在 11 个语言包里都有（ja、zh-Hant 已抽查）。复用的 `issuesSummary`、`warningsSummary`、`issuesDetails` 在 11 个包里本来就都有，已 grep。
- **"no in-repo producer sends that case"（没有任何生产方会发出这种情况）站得住**：
  - `applySeedBodies` 的失败路径都带 `error`；
  - `applyPublishedSeeds` 的服务缺失路径带 `error`；
  - seed-loader 推进 `errors[]` 的都是带 `message` 的 error 对象（`seed-loader.ts:1745` 等）。
  
  所以 `usePublishAllDrafts`、`PendingDraftsBar` 以 `seedError` 判断失败，在现有生产方下不会漏判。
- **测试**：6 个新用例覆盖了带句、不带句、只有 warning、混合、ja 种子失败、无文字的种子失败。消融 1（`userMessage ?? message`）有 3 条变红，消融 2（种子行回退到英文）有 2 条变红，两次恢复后 blob 都与 HEAD 一致。
- **声明**：`Clause-② yes (widening)`，`PublishHealth` 新增三个可选字段，并新增一个 i18n 键。按宽的一侧申报没有问题。
- **门禁**：派生 40 族，跑了 39 族，全部 exit 0。剩下的 1 族（ui `scripts/` 的 i18n 键门禁）标为 NOT MEASURED 并写明了原因，交给 CI。

### R1 · Acceptance notes 里点名的同类遗留没有 #N

Acceptance notes 写道：「Their toasts still print engine text verbatim, which is the same class of problem this PR fixes on the line」，也就是 `usePublishAllDrafts`、`PendingDraftsBar` 的 toast 仍然原样打印引擎文字和 `issues[].message`。dev 报告里对这一点的标注是 "noted, not filed"。

这和本 PR 修的是同一类缺陷，只是出现在另一个界面上。按 L1 规则，正文点名的范围外遗留需要 #N。请另立一张卡并在 Acceptance notes 里引用它。

### R2 · changeset 写"生产方现在会写客户句"，但这件事要等 #34513 落地才成立

changeset 原文：「The producer of a finding now writes the customer sentence (`userMessage`), and the line follows it」。在只有本 PR 的 main 上，没有任何生产方写 `userMessage`，生产方那一侧是 PR #34513，它是 Tier H，落地时间不定。如果本 PR 先落地，这句话在发版说明里就不属实。

正文第 4 行也还是按分支名指那个 PR，没有写 #34513。

二选一：
- 把 changeset 改成条件句，例如 "when the producer sends one (#34513)"，并在正文写 #34513；
- 或者在正文和欠单里写明"在 #34513 之后落地"。

### CI

我读的时候这个 head 上还有 19 项在跑，没有读到红。修完后我只读 delta，并会等 CI 全部跑完再给结论。

First review of this head. Card #32984, ruling 6929121584 (Q1 letter B, parameter 4), state 6933704412. Declaration face only: nothing under `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path in the 16 files.

### ① Derived judgments

- `PublishHealth.seedFailed?: boolean`, `PublishHealth.issues[].fix?` and `issues[].userMessage?` (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, type exported from `core.ts` and `index.tsx`): new optional members, a widening, right, and each is named in the changeset. The new `PublishHealthIssue` interface is not re-exported by name, so it adds no public symbol.
- `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed` (`@object-ui/i18n`): one new key, present in all eleven packs (`ar`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`), each a real translation, none an English copy. Right. `issuesSummary`, `warningsSummary` and `issuesDetails` are reused, not added.
- No key is renamed or removed and no member becomes required: right. One existing member changes what it guarantees, and the declaration's "nothing is removed or renamed" does not cover that: `seedError`, see S1.
- The ruling's console half holds. `PublishHealthLine` shows `issues[].userMessage` as received when the finding carries one (a non-empty string), keeps no per-code table, and speaks one generic pack sentence for the findings without one (`issuesSummary` when the set has an error, else `warningsSummary`). `message`, `fix` and the seed loader's text move under a closed "Technical details". A hand-built `PublishHealth` with only `seedError` still reads as failed (`seedFailed === true || !!seedError`).

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n` at `patch` with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, on the PR body and the changeset: right for new optional members and one pack key; nothing an author writes changes.
- The changeset sentence "The producer of a finding now writes the customer sentence" is true only once #34513 is on `main`; see the order note in ③.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: 34 success, 13 skipped, 10 still running (Test UI 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 13, 14, 15 and 16 of 16), none red. `Type Check UI` and `Lint UI` are green. The ui `scripts/` i18n key gates, which the dev left to CI, run inside Test UI and have not all answered yet.
- Order against #34513: none in code. This diff imports no spec type from that pull request; it reads `data.probes` through its own local cast and takes `userMessage` only when it is a non-empty string, so it compiles and behaves on `main` as it is. Landed first, every finding takes the generic sentence, which is the declared fallback of ruling parameter 4. Only the changeset's wording depends on #34513.
- Dev flag (Acceptance notes), `usePublishAllDrafts` and `PendingDraftsBar` still read `seedError` and print engine text: answered by S1 for the failure signal. The verbatim engine text in those toasts is the same class on another surface and stays the seat's follow-up to file.
- Tests: six new cases assert the pack sentence in `zh-Hans` and `ja`, the absence of the agent text on the line, and its presence under a closed `details`; two `publishHealthFromResponse` cases pin the non-empty-string reads and the loader finding object. They assert literals the implementation does not echo, so they are not circular.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no data read in the diff.

S1 (should-fix) — `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/publishHealth.ts`, `seedError`: on `main` it is set whenever `seedApplied.success === false`, and two readers in this repository use it as the failed-seed signal (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts:89`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/PendingDraftsBar.tsx:113`). After this diff it is absent when the producer sent no text, which the published response contract allows (`seedApplied.error` is optional and `errors` is `z.array(z.unknown())`), and both readers then report a clean publish ("All pending changes are live.") over a failed seed. Today's producers always send text, so it is not reachable on this tree, but the guarantee moved and the readers did not. Required: both readers take `seedFailed` (two lines, in this pull request or a card cited by number before landing), and the changeset names the changed reading of `seedError` beside its "nothing is removed or renamed".

N1 (nit) — `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: with a voiced error beside an unvoiced warning, the generic line takes the error sentence and the red face, although the only finding it speaks for is a warning.
